description: Musamimuk is an AI design editor. After you sign in, ChatGPT can list your designs, create a blank canvas, generate an editable poster from a prompt, make a library image, remove a background, analyze an owned image, or create a QR code. Designs open in the Musamimuk app to finish editing. Image generation uses your Musamimuk coins.
